title: Hearty Slovakian Potato Pie
description: A cozy, citrusy potato pie with chewy texture, made from charlotte potatoes and a fragrant lemon‑coriander sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking pan with parchment paper.
Boil diced potatoes in salted water until just tender, about 10 minutes, then drain and let cool.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled potatoes, diced carrot, grated cheese and mix until evenly distributed.
Melt vegan butter with olive oil in a skillet, then stir in lemon zest, lemon juice, ground coriander, ground cumin, salt and pepper until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Pour the citrusy sauce over the potato mixture and stir until everything is well coated.
Beat the eggs in a separate bowl and whisk them into the potato‑citrus mixture until fully incorporated.
Transfer the mixture into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula.
Bake for 35–40 minutes, or until the top is golden and the center is set.
Let the pie cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
